title: Wooden Tools to Charcoal
description: Wooden Tools to Charcoal is a datapack for any version technically but I recommend 1.20+!
body:
# **INFORMATION**

## **What is Wooden Tools to Charcoal?**
Why would you ask? It's in the name! But if you must know. This datapack allows you to turn Wooden tools into charcoal! You can use any wood tool to make the charcoal you also need cobblestone.

![Charcoal Recipe Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77531b5a631effb545b2b3fe89c588468fd9a707.png)

## **Why is Wooden Tools to Charcoal a thing?**
Wooden Tools to Charcoal is a thing because, when you start a world and get raw food but don't have coal to smelt it? Easy take your wooden tools and cobblestone and boom! No more raw food!

## **Why is Cobblestone in the recipe?**
Cobblestone is in the recipe because, it's like your smashing the cobblestone into the Wooden Tools. And that makes charcoal!
